lines.t: I'm buckling beneath the pressure life's demands
Reaching for escapes in all the wrong hands
Chasing quick comforts, pleasure that fades
Craving relief from the weight these worries make
Brother searching for strength
And fleeting pleasures only leaves a man empty
A real rest is found by refusing the poison
Offered by the world and standing firm
As Mashiach did, peace comes when a man lays his anxieties
Before the feet of the king and draws near
The spirit fills what is surrendered
Making a son mighty in discipline and hope
When they throw words like daggers and accuse
I rush to defend, fight, and explain my truth
None of it frees me, just another day
Tangled up, yoked to the old way
Let accusations fall without reply
Vindication does not come from men
But from Mashiach alone
A true brother walks away from the urge to explain
Refusing to be tied to those who pull him away from righteousness
Integrity is proven not by words
But by silent obedience and faithful living
The reward and freedom are found in the judgment of Mashiach
Never in arguments with men
See these old scars and patterns run deep
Reacting to pain, not knowing the sea
Is this my sorrow?
Wounds from the past
Where is the root?
And will healing come at last
Healing burns brightest
When a man takes full responsibility
Exposing every hurt and habit to the light
Instead of offering excuses or blame
Root out the flesh by surrender
And trust the king with both pain and sin
Holding nothing back
True restoration is born in humility
Where brokenness is met with mercy
and what was secret is touched by the hands of Messiah for new life.
Take hold of the yoke that Messiah bore.
Cast off the burdens and strive no more.
Turn from the fleeting, refuse the shame.
Rise now as sons he calls each one by name.
Take hold of the yoke that Mashiach bore
Cast off the burdens and strive no more
Turn from the fleeting, refuse the shame
Rise now as sons, he calls each one by name
Thank you.
